movies.title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King
movies.synopsis: Asta and the Magic Knights face their greatest challenge when Conrad Leto, a former Wizard King, returns alongside resurrected Wizard Kings seeking to destroy the Clover Kingdom.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.synopsis: Paul Atreides joins Chani and the Fremen in their fight against the forces that destroyed his family. As he embraces his destiny, Paul must confront visions of a dangerous future.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.synopsis: When the Time Variance Authority pulls Wade Wilson into a mission to save his universe, Deadpool recruits a reluctant Wolverine for an unpredictable adventure across the multiverse.

movies.title: Inside Out 2
movies.synopsis: As Riley enters her teenage years, Joy and the other emotions encounter new arrivals, including Anxiety, Envy, and Embarrassment, forcing the team to navigate the challenges of growing up.

movies.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
movies.synopsis: During the first day of an alien invasion, Samira finds herself trapped in New York City, where deadly creatures hunt by sound. Alongside a stranger, she struggles to survive the terrifying chaos.

movies.title: Gladiator II
movies.synopsis: After Roman forces conquer his home, Lucius is forced into the Colosseum as a gladiator. Driven by revenge and inspired by the legacy of Maximus, he fights against the corrupt rulers of Rome.

movies.title: Kung Fu Panda 4
movies.synopsis: Po is chosen to become the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace and must find a new Dragon Warrior. Alongside the clever fox Zhen, he faces a powerful sorceress capable of transforming into his enemies.

movies.title: Smile 2
movies.synopsis: As pop star Skye Riley prepares for a major world tour, increasingly terrifying events begin to disrupt her life. She must confront a sinister force while struggling with the pressures of fame and her troubled past.

movies.title: The Fall Guy
movies.synopsis: Colt Seavers, a stuntman returning after a career-threatening accident, joins a film directed by his former girlfriend. When the movie's leading star disappears, Colt becomes entangled in a dangerous conspiracy.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.synopsis: Physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer leads the Manhattan Project, a secret mission to develop the world's first atomic bomb. As his scientific achievements reshape history, he struggles with their devastating consequences.

movies.title: Longlegs
movies.synopsis: FBI agent Lee Harker investigates a series of bizarre family murders connected to a mysterious serial killer known as Longlegs. As she uncovers disturbing occult clues, the case reveals a terrifying personal connection.

movies.title: Despicable Me 4
movies.synopsis: Gru and his family welcome a new baby while trying to stay ahead of escaped criminal Maxime Le Mal. With danger approaching, Gru, Lucy, and the Minions must work together to protect their loved ones.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
movies.synopsis: John Wick discovers a possible path to freedom from the High Table, but powerful enemies stand in his way. His fight takes him across the globe toward a decisive confrontation that could change his fate.

movies.title: Abigail
movies.synopsis: A group of criminals kidnaps Abigail, a young ballerina, and takes her to an isolated mansion for a ransom. Their plan quickly falls apart when they discover that their seemingly innocent captive hides a terrifying secret.

movies.title: Moana 2
movies.synopsis: After receiving an unexpected call from her ancestors, Moana embarks on a daring voyage across distant seas with Maui and a new crew. Together, they seek to reconnect the scattered peoples of Oceania.
movies.director: David Derrick Jr., Jason Hand, Dana Ledoux Miller

movies.title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
movies.synopsis: Miami detectives Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett become fugitives after their late police captain is accused of corruption. Determined to clear his name, they must uncover the truth while evading the authorities.

movies.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
movies.synopsis: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on another disturbing case involving a family plagued by supernatural events. As the haunting intensifies, the Warrens confront a terrifying mystery that tests their faith and courage.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.synopsis: Woody, Buzz, Jessie, and the other toys face a new challenge when Bonnie becomes fascinated with Lilypad, a smart tablet with its own ideas about playtime. As technology changes their world, the toys must find a way to reconnect with their child.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible — Dead Reckoning
movies.synopsis: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team race to stop a powerful artificial intelligence known as the Entity from threatening global security. Pursued by dangerous enemies, Ethan must track down a crucial key before it falls into the wrong hands.

movies.title: Anyone But You
movies.synopsis: Bea and Ben have an awkward first date that leaves them disliking each other. When they reunite at a destination wedding in Australia, they pretend to be a couple, only to discover that their feelings may be more complicated than they expected.

movies.title: The Batman Part II
movies.synopsis: Bruce Wayne continues his mission to protect Gotham City as Batman. Facing new dangers in a city plagued by crime and corruption, he must rely on his detective skills and determination to uncover the truth.
